purpose: Exercise the contact and presence-memory pathway that the baseline factorial left unobserved, without fitting historical outcomes or changing core equations.

initialization: co-locate the insurgent focal formation with the government focal formation at the government's generated locality and microzone
set both focal formations effective, available, rested, fully supplied, and command-capable
re-baseline initial supply after fixture normalization

acceptance_gate: Every matched seed must produce at least one latent focal contact, source hashes must remain stable, supply residuals must remain within tolerance, and the challenge must recover a declared contact/presence contrast before any interpretation of the parent factorial is attempted.
falsifiers: a focal pair remains co-located and effective but produces no latent contact in a seed
the memory treatment changes neither presence memory nor the declared control outcome
recorded contacts are mistaken for latent contacts
any cell changes the live model hash during execution
interpretation: This challenge isolates a mechanism pathway; it is not a historical fit, a transfer test, an efficacy estimate, or a license to modify the core. Failure is evidence that the challenge or observation operator is still inadequate, not evidence for a general theory.
